notes: Higher in tumour than matched noncancerous tissue; high expression correlated with liver metastasis and relatively poorer prognosis in stage IV CRC. Published as MALAT-1. Overexpressed in stage I tumours that metastasised vs those that did not; association was stage- and histology-specific. Direction left empty: tumour vs normal tissue not compared in abstract (MALAT-1 also highly expressed in healthy lung).

ZFN knockout (1,000-fold silencing) in human lung tumour cells: impaired migration, fewer xenograft nodules; ASOs prevented metastasis. Regulates metastasis-associated gene expression, not splicing; no single gene target named in abstract. Conflict of interest: five authors employed by ISIS Pharmaceuticals.

cohort_description: 46 HCCs, 4 focal nodular hyperplasias, 7 cirrhoses (cDNA array screen)
notes: Most up-regulated gene in HCC in the screen. Detected in blood of HCC patients; authors propose it as a potential biomarker. siRNA knockdown in 2 HCC cell lines altered several genes; none named in abstract.
Transcript levels significantly reduced in breast cancer vs adjacent unaffected normal epithelium; sample count not stated. Cell-line work shows GAS5 controls apoptosis and growth; no target named.

cohort_description: 53 of 56 prostatic tumours vs matched nonneoplastic tissue
notes: Published as DD3. Prostate-specific: no expression in 18 normal non-prostate tissues or in other tumour types and cell lines sampled. Authors propose it as a diagnostic marker.

let-7 expression lower in lung tumours than normal lung tissue; RAS protein higher in lung tumours. Abstract names the let-7 family; recorded against let-7a-1 as family representative, matching this paper's interaction rows.

ANRIL is CDKN2B-AS1. ANRIL (and CBX7) found at elevated levels in prostate cancer tissues. Sample count not stated.
PTENP1 locus selectively lost in human cancer; tumour types not named in abstract.

cohort_description: 102 prostate tissues and cell lines (RNA-seq discovery cohort)
notes: Published as PCAT-1. PCAT-1 and PRC2 expression patterns stratified patient tissues into molecular subtypes; implicated in a subset of prostate cancer patients. Direction not stated in abstract. Cohort count covers the PCAT discovery screen, not PCAT-1 specifically.

clinical_association: independently predicts metastasis and prostate cancer-specific mortality
notes: Published as SChLAP1 (LINC00913). Overexpressed in a subset of prostate cancers. Cohort sizes not stated in abstract.
Isoform CCAT1-L, "transcribed specifically in human colorectal cancers". Direction left empty: abstract states specificity, not a comparison with normal colon. Erratum 2014.
Upregulated in HCC metastases and associated with poor prognosis. Direction left empty: comparison is metastases within cancer, not vs normal. Cohort size not stated.

PVT1 copy number co-increased in more than 98% of MYC-copy-increase cancers; PVT1 RNA correlates with MYC protein in primary tumours. Tumour types not named. 8q24 gain and poor prognosis is background, so not recorded as this paper's finding.

cohort_description: 2,394 tumour specimens from 12 cancer types (pan-cancer SCNA survey)
notes: Published as FAL1 (focally amplified lncRNA on chromosome 1). Copy number and expression correlated with outcomes in ovarian cancer. Ovarian subset size not stated. siRNA inhibited tumour growth in vivo.

Most significantly overexpressed lncRNA in prostate cancer among putatively ERalpha-regulated lncRNAs; associated with progression in "two large clinical cohorts" (sizes not stated). High-NEAT1 cells recalcitrant to androgen or AR antagonists.
LED is SMIM10L2A. Promoter hypermethylation analysis shows silencing of LED in human tumours; tumour types not named.

cohort_description: Training cohort: 153 primary CRC tissues and 44 matched normal mucosae; validation cohort n = 165
notes: Published as ciRS-7. Upregulated vs matched normal mucosa (P = 0.0018); overexpression associated with poor survival in both cohorts. Independent risk factor in multivariate analysis reached P = 0.0324 in validation but P = 0.0656 in training.

TMZR1-eRNA expression markedly lower in healthy brain tissue and PBMC. Knockdown sensitised patient glioblastoma cells with higher eRNA expression to temozolomide (functional; mechanism via STAT3 is in interactions).
Abstract: "a higher amount of MYC eRNA is observed in chronic pancreatitis and in pancreatic cancer patients". Comparator group and sample counts not stated.

notes: Identified as a susceptibility eRNA in a pan-cancer eRNA TWAS; abstract does not say for which cancer type. Functional validation was in prostate cancer cells (see interactions).
